about.title: About Me
about.description: Full-stack Developer with 1+ year of experience building production web and mobile applications using React, React Native, and NestJS. Experienced in AI-assisted development workflows to accelerate delivery across complex features — from UI implementation to API integration. Currently leading CONUT, a group-buying platform built on Next.js, NestJS, and TiDB, applying system-level thinking to architect scalable end-to-end solutions.
